 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

A Phlebotomist serves patients by identifying the best method for retrieving blood; preparing specimens for laboratory testing; and packing and shipping procedures

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Verifies test orders by comparing information with requisition forms, bringing discrepancies to the attention of unit personnel.

- Verifies patient by reading patient identification.

- Obtains blood specimens by performing venipunctures.

- Maintains specimen integrity by using aseptic technique, following department procedures; observing isolation procedures.

- Tracks collected specimens by initialing, dating, and noting times of collection; maintaining daily tallies of collections performed.

- Maintains quality results by following department procedures and testing schedule, identifying, and reporting needed changes.

- Maintains safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following standards and procedures; complying with legal regulations.

- Resolves unusual test orders by contacting Natera’s mobile phlebotomy team; referring unresolved orders back to the originator for further clarification; notifying Natera of unresolved orders.

- Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations.

- Enhances phlebotomy department reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.

- This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) to perform the job.

- The mobile phlebotomist is responsible for updating job statuses and adding tracking information in Skedulo.

Normal's hardware runs the most memory-bound parts of large-model inference inside memory itself, rather than shuttling weights to a processor. The software that makes this programmable doesn't exist yet in any standard form. The runtime is the layer the rest of that software runs through: it is how compiled programs get loaded, scheduled, and executed on our hardware. You will own its design and much of its implementation, and set its technical direction.



This is a senior, hands-on role. Our chip is pre-silicon, so you will build the runtime against our simulators and FPGA prototypes first, behind one interface, so that software above the runtime doesn't change when silicon arrives.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Runtime Architecture: Own the design of the runtime: device management, memory allocation and host-device transfer, executable loading, and command submission. Success means the compiler and serving layers program our hardware through one stable interface.

 - Hardware Abstraction: Hide the differences between simulators, FPGA prototypes, silicon, and later hardware generations behind that interface.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a GRC Analyst to join our Compliance & Security team and help make risk management, audit and compliance a continuous part of how Supabase runs. You’ll work closely with engineering, security, IT, and legal to help us define our risk tolerance, keep our compliance programs (including SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022) current, test controls on a rolling basis, and answer customer and vendor security reviews quickly and accurately.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Run risk assessments across the company and major product changes. Score likelihood and impact, propose treatments, and bring the results to leadership to inform risk tolerance decisions.

 - Maintain the risk register, track remediation to closure, and report status to compliance and security leadership.

 - Monitor controls on a rolling basis, using automated tests where they exist and manual testing where they don’t. Triage failures, prioritize by the risk register, and align each finding with an owner and a due date.

 - Support internal audit, whether performed by an external partner or in-house: propose scope from the risk register, supply evidence, and track findings to closure.

 - Run day-to-day operations for our compliance programs: evidence collection, control owner follow-up, and readiness ahead of each audit period.

 - Extend continuous control validation beyond what our compliance platform covers. Build custom tests with AI coding tools, work with engineering and IT to pull evidence from source systems instead of collecting screenshots, and check that each test proves what the control requires.
